summary: Verified public backend APIs, owner auth, protected inbox boundaries, responsive dashboard, logout persistence, and OAuth handoff. Core app flows pass; Google OAuth is blocked by provider redirect URI configuration.

integration_issues.issue: Google returns Error 400 redirect_uri_mismatch for the configured callback URL; account linking cannot proceed.

action_items: Add https://email-cleanup-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com/api/oauth/gmail/callback to the Google OAuth client's authorized redirect URIs and verify the client secret in backend/.env.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend build emits a React Hook exhaustive-deps warning in the deployed source; review the stale dependency warning before production hardening.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; live accounts endpoint returned an empty list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL tested. Owner credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Mobile viewport 390x844 had no horizontal overflow. Owner login, invalid login rejection, logout/localStorage clearing, empty state, protected APIs, health, and build passed. OAuth reaches Google but fails redirect_uri_mismatch before callback.
rca of the issue: GET /api/oauth/gmail/start correctly generates an authorization URL using GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI. Navigating from Add Gmail to Google produces Error 400 redirect_uri_mismatch, so the Google Cloud OAuth client does not authorize the callback currently configured by the backend. This is external provider configuration, not an app-side callback bug; update the authorized redirect URI and retest the full callback/duplicate-account flow.
